_meta.description: Scenario/objective card library for the Legion app. Covers the current (post-'2.6 refresh', July 2024 onward) Battle Card system: a 9-card Battle Deck per player (3 Primary Objective, 3 Secondary Objective, 3 Advantage), built collaboratively during Setup's 'Building a Mission' step.

game_formats.recon-600: 600-point 'Recon' format -- smaller board, shorter game. Uses its own comparable-but-different card set, not yet catalogued here.

_meta.deprecated_system_warning: IMPORTANT: an older card system (separate Objective / Deployment / Condition cards, 800pt standard / 500pt skirmish format) was replaced by the Primary/Secondary/Advantage system described here as of the Legion 2.6.0 Core Rulebook update (~July 2024). The old cards are explicitly no longer supported for play. If any other file in this project (e.g. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) still references 800pt/500pt or 'Objective/Deployment/Condition' terminology, that's now confirmed stale and needs fixing -- see docs/TODO.md.
_meta.battle_deck_rule: 9 cards per player: 3 Primary Objective + 3 Secondary Objective + 3 Advantage, no duplicates. Corresponding Map cards accompany Primary Objectives.
_meta.distinct_from_campaigns_feature: AMG also publishes non-competitive 'Scenario' cards for narrative/thematic play (distinct from competitive Primary/Secondary/Advantage cards) -- these are NOT the same thing as this app's user-defined Campaigns feature, which remains an intentional placeholder per docs/TODO.md and docs/DECISIONS.md. AMG's official narrative Scenario cards are a separate, uncatalogued gap -- see below.
_meta.verification_status: EARLY SEED, LOW CONFIDENCE ON COMPLETENESS. Only 3 of the current ruleset's ~6 total Primary Objective cards have names confirmed via independent sources (roster_verified:true). 3 more names were found but could not be confirmed as current, correctly-categorized, or complete (roster_verified:false). ZERO Secondary Objective cards, ZERO Advantage cards, and ZERO Recon-format (600pt) cards are catalogued yet -- this is a much thinner seed than keywords/units/upgrades/command-cards were at the same stage. Every victory_condition and points_of_interest field is null: not filled from memory, for the same reasons as every other library so far. See docs/TODO.md for the full gap list.
